items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Melba, she was a great jazz artist. I told you I saw her. She had a good band.

ctx.x: Melba, she was a great jazz artist. I told you I saw her. She had a good band. I mean, certain instruments I just . . . there are certain instruments I think a woman does not have the strength to play, you know what I mean? There was a weakness somewhere in the woodwinds with the orchestra, and I don‘t like female drummers. Oh, it was swinging, but it left a little something to be desired, for me.
Actually, we didn‘t talk about Ray Charles, and that was my thought, but it completely slipped my mind. I know you did the tribute album to him in 1993.
